description: This PHP source file contains a test class 'LDAPTestServiceAnonBindTest' which performs unit testing of LDAP connection functionalities, particularly anonymous binding, with various configurations. It includes setup routines to configure LDAP server settings, mock services, and multiple test cases to validate connection success and failure scenarios.

classes.name: LDAPTestServiceAnonBindTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing LDAP anonymous connection and related configurations in the LDAP service within the OrangeHRM system.

methods.name: testAnonymousConnection
methods.description: Tests that an LDAP anonymous connection can be successfully established using the configured LDAP settings.

methods.name: testInvalidHost
methods.description: Tests LDAP connection failure with an invalid host to verify proper exception handling.

methods.name: testInvalidPort
methods.description: Tests LDAP connection failure with an invalid port number.

methods.name: testEncryptionWithPort
methods.description: Tests LDAP connection failure when using SSL encryption with the specified port.
